name: MDPA
summary: An obscure substituted methylenedioxyphenethylamine with little history of human use. The drugs pharmacological profile is largely unknown, it is suspected to exhibit similar properties to other MDxx compounds. The drug may be a monoamine releaser and or a reuptake inhibitor.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

fact.en: Like all MDxx compounds, it carries a methylenedioxy ring, a small ring of two oxygens and one carbon fused to the benzene ring, the same feature found in safrole from sassafras oil.
fact.zh: 和所有 MDxx 化合物一樣，它帶有亞甲二氧基環，也就是由兩個氧與一個碳組成、與苯環相連的小環，這也是黃樟油中黃樟素的特徵。
fact.zhHans: 和所有 MDxx 化合物一样，它带有亚甲二氧基环，也就是由两个氧与一个碳组成、与苯环相连的小环，这也是黄樟油中黄樟素的特征。
